corner.description: Top-left quarter-round corner, the two stems bent through a quarter circle with one gold leaf, meeting the strip's stems at the centre of its right and bottom edges.

gold-leaf-scroll.description: A horizontal vector border of two wave stems, one dark plum and one gold, crossing each other in opposite phase along the strip. Pointed gold leaves with a cream vein spring from the crests and troughs. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
gold-leaf-scroll.title: Gold leaf scroll border
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes the strip with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

corner.description: Top-left quarter-round corner, the stem bent through a quarter circle with one small gold quatrefoil without red dots, meeting the strip's stem at the centre of its right and bottom edges.

gold-quatrefoil-vine.description: A horizontal vector border of a thin dark plum wave stem carrying gold four-lobed flowers with a gold centre and a red dot on each lobe, one on each crest and trough, with a small pointed gold leaf between them. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
gold-quatrefoil-vine.title: Gold quatrefoil vine border
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes the strip with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

corner.description: Top-left quarter-round corner, the red band and gold ribbon bent as concentric quarter rings, meeting the strip's band on its right and bottom edges.

gold-wave-ribbon.description: A horizontal vector border of a solid red band with dark plum edges, across which a broad gold ribbon outlined in dark plum runs in regular rising and falling waves. Flat colours; the band and the ribbon continue across the left and right edges. The band is opaque and the thin strips above and below it are transparent.
gold-wave-ribbon.title: Gold wave ribbon on red band
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes the strip with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting. The band is opaque, so it covers whatever lies under it.

corner.description: Top-left quarter-round corner, the stem bent through a quarter circle with three red berries of decreasing size along it, meeting the strip's stem at the centre of its right and bottom edges.

red-berry-vine.description: A horizontal vector border of a thin dark plum wave stem carrying clusters of round red berries on short stalks, a large berry with smaller ones beside it on each crest and trough and single berries along the slopes. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
red-berry-vine.title: Red berry vine border
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.

corner.description: Top-left quarter-round corner, the stem bent through a quarter circle with one small red rosette, meeting the strip's stem at the centre of its right and bottom edges.

red-rosette-vine.description: A horizontal vector border of a thin dark plum wave stem carrying red six-petalled rosettes with a gold centre, one on each crest and trough, with pointed gold leaves bearing a cream vein between them. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
red-rosette-vine.title: Red rosette vine border

corner.description: Top-left quarter-round corner, the stem bent through a quarter circle with one larger red trefoil, meeting the strip's stem at the centre of its right and bottom edges.

red-trefoil-vine.description: A horizontal vector border of a thin dark plum wave stem carrying groups of three small red three-lobed flowers with gold centres on each crest and trough, with a pointed gold leaf bearing a cream vein on the slopes between the groups. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
